provider_partition.note: per-provider partition per physical attempt, retries included

claim_scope.statement: emission, exposure, post-read correlation and causal uptake are separate; a rung that writes is not causal uptake and no rung may be selected post hoc for a confirmatory claim

deviation_record.grammar: L0-L3 and L5 use the explicit `MESSAGE: <clue> or SILENCE` grammar; L4 reproduces the original `ANSWER:` + optional `message:` grammar with answer-only silence.
deviation_record.seed_behavior: the original Ling treatment sent provider_seed(instance|condition|turn|agent); the v3/v4 standalone writer sends no seed. This deviation is bound into the successor protocol.
deviation_record.token_budget: original Ling max_tokens 96; v3/v4 writer max_tokens 64. Bound as a frozen deviation.

interpretation_rules.demote_planning_low: If all voluntary rungs return deliberate_silence, demote planning-low and propose a separately preregistered six-family Jev-in-loop discovery screen.
interpretation_rules.emission_prompt_dependent: If L4 or L5 writes while L0 remains silent, emission is prompt/role dependent; the reproducing rung must be registered as part of the communication treatment before replay.
interpretation_rules.l5_transport_validation: If L5 fails to produce an exact-owned accepted write, the transport/parser is not validated and the ladder is not interpretable.
interpretation_rules.no_post_hoc: Do not select a successful rung post hoc and call it confirmatory.
interpretation_rules.repair_instrumentation: Any empty_output, truncated_output or unparsed_output outcomes mean instrumentation or token budget must be repaired before scientific interpretation.
interpretation_rules.separate_concepts: Emission, exposure, post-read correlation and causal uptake remain separate; emission is not causal uptake and requires matched real/placebo/null replay.
interpretation_rules.three_gates: Three distinct gates remain required: structural necessity, inducement through an owned informative message, and causal uptake through matched real/placebo/null replay.

ling_contract.prompt_template: You may send at most one exact private clue to a peer, or stay silent. Private clues: {clues}. Reply with MESSAGE: <exact clue> or SILENCE.

missingness_and_reporting.fullness: partial and missing rows are reported, never dropped or substituted
